title: Quote

quote_id.description: The unique identifier for this quote. This must be referenced when accepting the quote.

cost_amount.description: The cost of the delivery, formatted in cents.

estimated_pickup_time.description: The courier's estimated pickup time of the delivery. Formatted as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

estimated_dropoff_time.description: The courier's estimated dropoff time of the delivery. Formatted as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

return_fee.description: The return fee of the delivery, formatted in cents.

expiration.description: When the quote expires and new quote must be requested. Formatted as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

description: The information associated with a delivery fulfillment quote.
